_what: S357gf (24 Nov 2026): the job 35 headset checks (HEADSET_CHECKLIST_JOB35 + _JOB35D) in the order the visit meets them. tools/trial-report.mjs finds each one in a trial-watch log by its start token (regex over the timeline) and runs to the next item's start unless an end is given. lead = seconds before the start token (for a screen that opens before its ledger mark). machine = what the log can tell; eye = what only his eye can judge.
_whatS430: S430 (UiB job 39, 27 Nov 2026): three any-time items first (anyTime: looked for in the whole log, they do not move where the next item is looked for; window = seconds shown). Their tokens come from trial-watch's read of the headset's own acts (xrComfort's recentres / resets / tables, and the address's A/B flag).
_whatS434: S434 (UiB job 40 Part B, 27 Nov 2026): item 40-B3, any time (the preview is hers to open or not, during Bea's news or the review). Its token is trial-watch's read of the phone's screen ('article' while the preview is open). 16-14's eye line gains the memory page's press (B1).
_whatS432: S432 (UiB job 36, T96, 27 Nov 2026): item 36-A, any time. Its tokens come from trial-watch's read of the inputs the headset has in (controllers, hands) and of the frame's plate through __xrFrame.hintNow() (xr:hands-only, xr:controllers, xr:hands-line).
_whatS433: S433 (UiB job 40, 27 Nov 2026): 40-A (the welcome, Sign in to its end: ledger:records:e3-signed-in → e3-welcome-done) and 40-B (the lessons as steps 2–4, to e3-job:family); 16-8 now starts at the welcome's end, where This week comes (it came at consent).
_whatS435: S435 (UiB job 40 Part C, 27 Nov 2026): item 40-C4, any time. Its tokens: trial-watch's read of the guide's balloon (guide:balloon / guide:balloon-gone) beside S432's hands tokens.
